dana: Quick thread to lock down the whats-new bullets and make sure the SDK snippets & curl examples are publish-ready for tomorrow's docs deploy. Keeping this short.
mike: on it. PRs to include: #6011 (whats-new draft), #6014 (embed curl + examples), #6022 (sdk snippet parity). I'll handle TS parity.
yasmin: spotted a parameter mismatch in staging  some pages use `embed_model`, others use `model`. propose we standardize on `model` and add redirects from the old paths.
harry: i can open the redirect PR. grep found two pages linking to `/embed` and one legacy anchor. will 301 them to `/embeddings`.
dana: for the whats-new, product asked for bullets (one sentence each) with CTAs. avoid jargon; marketing prefers plain phrasing.
mike: small wording suggestion for embedding perf: say "reduced latency for short inputs" rather than technical "tail latency". clearer for customers.
yasmin: SDK note: streaming shape changed vs older examples. old snippets assumed chunk.text; new client yields event dicts. updated python snippet below for publish:
```python
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_KEY"))
for ev in client.generate_stream(model="kestrel", prompt="Hi"):
    if ev.get("type") == "token":
        print(ev.get("delta", ""), end="")
    elif ev.get("type") == "done":
        print("\n-- stream complete --")
```
mike: add a one-line preface: "Streaming emits token and control events (type: 'token'|'done')." Also note routers may emit `warning` events during capacity events.
harry: canonical curl snippet for the whats-new (using `model`):
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-small","input":"example text"}'
```
dana: known-issues block (short bullets):
- "Embeddings from quantized backends may differ slightly from float backends; validate on representative prompts before switching in production."
- "During high load requests may be routed to compatible model variants which can affect outputs; pin model versions for deterministic results."
mike: i've added a brief note in the whats-new about fallback routing and the embeddings caveat. kept both one sentence with CTAs to the deeper pages.
yasmin: CI check: docs-lint passed (build 4522) 44c
harry: ops-bot scheduled the docs window: ops-bot: deploy-window 02:00-03:00 UTC. remember to reindex search if we modify anchors.
ops-bot: Reminder | reindex-docs-search required if anchors change.
dana: timeline: final copy by 17:00 PT, freeze at 18:00 PT, deploy in ops window. reviewers: @mike on #6011, @yasmin on #6014.
mike: running a final grep for /embed vs /embeddings and stale anchors, will paste results here in 15m.
yasmin: i'll patch the python snippet and add the small FAQ note about streaming shape.
harry: once redirects are opened i'll link them in the whats-new so anchors don't 404.
dana: final checklist: standardize curl param to `model`, update python streaming snippet, add small known-issues bullets, open redirects for legacy embed paths, run link sweep, reindex search. i'll post the final whats-new diff here when everything's merged. Pinning to #docs for visibility. :thumbsup:
